messages:
ellie: FYI perf regression on multi-GPU nightly for tp=2, pp=4, batch=8. Token/s down ~35% compared to baseline. nvprof/nsys shows NCCL allreduce not overlapping with compute after cudaGraph replay.

kai: timeline?

ellie: pasted nsys timeline snippet:
```
# simplified timeline
GPU0: compute (stream 1) -> cudaGraphReplay -> host sync -> NCCL allreduce (stream 0)
GPU1: compute (stream 2) -> NCCL allreduce queued on stream 0 (blocked)
```

maria: so compute isn't overlapping with nccl on same GPU because replay forced serialization?

ash: reminds me of when kvcache prefetch used an external stream and got captured in the graph, switching affinity on replay.

ellie: exact. kvcache prefetch issues a cudaMemcpyAsync on an external prefetch stream. When we capture compute graphs while prefetch is active, the capture ends up recording implicit host-device sync points and the replay sequence serializes compute -> host sync -> NCCL. Result: compute cannot overlap with comm.

sam: do we have kernel-selection traces? can we see whether cudnn/cublas picked a different algorithm during replay?

ellie: yes — logs show kernel selection fallback during replay: `matmul_kernel_v2_f32 -> fallback matmul_scalar`. Also workspace query returned different alignment/size inside capture path which triggered fallback.

kai: that looks like two separate sources: stream-affinity/external-stream capture + nondeterministic kernel choice inside capture. any repro steps?

ellie: repro on staging: `./run_infer --tp 2 --pp 4 --batch 8 --kv-prefetch --use-cudagraph`. I pushed `cg-repro.sh` to /tmp. Run with `nsys profile --output=trace` and inspect host->device syncs after graph launch.

maria: short mitigation options: 1) pin prefetch to compute stream (avoid external stream capture), 2) disable capture for kv-prefetch ops, 3) explicitly associate NCCL launches with compute stream.

ash: operational patch idea: before we capture, run a tiny warmup matmul to force kernel selection deterministically (so capture won't see fallback). Also ensure prefetch uses same stream or is quiesced before capture.

sam: I'll try a minimal fix: (A) change kvcache prefetch to use compute stream, (B) ensure ncclCommLaunch uses stream handle explicitly, (C) add warmup matmul call before graph capture. Will open a PR and attach perf numbers.

kai: assign to @sam, target a 48h hotfix. Also add a nightly perf test variant that exercises cudagraph + kvprefetch to detect regressions.

ellie: traces linked: https://internal/trace/2387654321 — includes full nsys and `cublas_log` dump. cc @oncall:opsbot

opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-045 - perf-regression - comm/compute overlap

maria: :thumbsup:

ellie: thanks everyone, will follow up with PR diff and before/after perf numbers.
